market.what: EDTA (today's tool for Ca at pH 13-14), world; only a small slice is scale control in alkaline electrolysis
market.method: QYR $514M (2025); ~106 kt/yr x ~$4.8/kg est. agrees; nearest real pH-14 antiscalant use is Bayer alumina (MAX HT, 18+ plants)

value.logic: est. 2033 electrochemical lime/cement ~2 Mt/yr; scale adds ~10% cell voltage + ~5% downtime ~ $10/t -> $20M/yr. Upside if it also works in Bayer liquor: $2-20M/yr saved per plant
value.revenue_logic: 2 Mt x ~0.2 kg/t dose x $15/kg = $6M pool x ~60% share (few buyers)
value.margin_logic: macrocycle costs more to make than phosphonates; small volume, sole-source add-in

trend.drivers: low-carbon cement demand (~8-11%/yr per reports); CBAM and ETS on cement; but Sublime paused Holyoke after DOE grant cut
trend.deadline: EU CBAM: first certificate surrender for 2026 cement imports in 2027

competition.notes: no startup found selling a pH-14 antiscalant; buyers fix fouling by process design. Sublime >$200M raised ($75M CRH/Holcim) but lost $87M DOE award, paused Dec 2025

lab.synth: macrocycle: calix[4]arene from catalog p-tBu-calixarene, 4-5 steps (dealkylation, upper-rim carboxyl, lower-rim amide arms); 3 variants
lab.test: static jar test per NACE TM0374 adapted to pH 13.5 with Ca(OH)2/CaCO3 supersaturation, ICP-OES Ca; then 200 h bench electrolyzer voltage-rise test; university or water-treatment lab
lab.logic: synth 13 wk + jar 2 wk + cell 3 wk; synth ~$30k + ICP ~$30-80/sample + cell test ~$10k

sale.gates: buyer bench + 1,000 h pilot electrolyzer; TSCA PMN (90 d) / REACH for new substance; depends on buyers restarting plants
